arxiv-2010-13573.title: ATLAS hardware-based Endcap Muon Trigger for future upgrades PubID: pubid: From ATL-DAQ-PROC-2020-021. Published with permission by CERN.
arxiv-2010-13573.creator: Yuya Mino, on behalf of ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-2010-13573.description: Abstract The LHC is expected to increase its center-of-mass energy from 13 TeV to 14 TeV for Run 3 scheduled from 2022 to 2024. After Run 3 , upgrades for the High-Luminosity-LHC ( HL-LHC ) programme are planned and the operation will start in 2027, increasing the instantaneous luminosity to 5.0 – 7.5 times its nominal luminosity.

arxiv-2103-00374.title: Multiscale Solar Wind Turbulence Properties inside and near Switchbacks measured by Parker Solar Probe
arxiv-2103-00374.creator: Mihailo M. Martinović, Kristopher G. Klein, Jia Huang, Benjamin D. G. Chandran, Justin C. Kasper, Emily Lichko, Trevor Bowen, Christopher H. K. Chen, Lorenzo Matteini, Michael Stevens, Anthony W. Case, Stuart D. Bale
arxiv-2103-00374.description: Abstract Parker Solar Probe (PSP) routinely observes magnetic field deflections in the solar wind at distances less than 0.3 au from the Sun. These deflections are related to structures commonly called ’switchbacks’ (SBs), whose origins and characteristic properties are currently debated.

arxiv-2111-10745.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Nicky Qiu. The global pandemic of COVID-19 has fundamentally changed how people interact, especially with the introduction of technology-based measures that aim at curbing the spread of the virus. As the country that currently implements one of the tightest technology-based COVID prevention policy, China has protected its citizen with a prolonged peaceful time of zero case as well as a fast reaction to potential upsurging of the disease.

arxiv-2306-14668.title: A Dual-Band 28/38-GHz Power Amplifier With Inter-Band Suppression in 22-nm FD-SOI CMOS for Multi-Standard mm-Wave 5G Communications
arxiv-2306-14668.creator: Abbas Nasri, Alireza Yousefi, and Reza Nikandish
arxiv-2306-14668.description: Abstract In this article, we present a dual-band 28/38-GHz power amplifier (PA) with inter-band suppression for millimeter-wave 5G communications. The dual-band operation is achieved using a center-tapped transformer network with an extra resonator which can provide optimum load impedance of the transistor in the two bands and synthesize a short-circuit between the two bands.

arxiv-2404-18614.title: A Few Projective Classes of (Non-Hausdorff) Topological Spaces
arxiv-2404-18614.creator: Jean Goubault-Larrecq
arxiv-2404-18614.description: Abstract A class of topological spaces is projective (resp., ω \omega -projective) if and only if projective systems of spaces (resp., with a countable cofinal subset of indices) in the class are still in the class. A certain number of classes of Hausdorff spaces are known to be, or not to be, ( ω \omega -) projective.

arxiv-2405-01327.title: Constrained Reinforcement Learning Under Model Mismatch
arxiv-2405-01327.creator: Zhongchang Sun, Sihong He, Fei Miao, Shaofeng Zou
arxiv-2405-01327.description: Abstract Existing studies on constrained reinforcement learning (RL) may obtain a well-performing policy in the training environment. However, when deployed in a real environment, it may easily violate constraints that were originally satisfied during training because there might be model mismatch between the training and real environments.

arxiv-2507-11794.title: Real-Time Cloth Simulation Using WebGPU: Evaluating Limits of High-Resolution Cloth Model
arxiv-2507-11794.creator: Nak-Jun Sung, Jun Ma, TaeHeon Kim, Yoo-joo Choi, Min-Hyung Choi, Min Hong
arxiv-2507-11794.description: Abstract This study explores the capabilities of WebGPU, an emerging web graphics paradigm, for real-time cloth simulation. Traditional WebGL-based methods have been in handling complex physical simulations due to their emphasis on graphics rendering rather than general-purpose GPU (GPGPU) operations.

arxiv-2509-13174.title: PDE-Based Bayesian Hierarchical Modeling for Event Spread, with Application to COVID-19 Infection
arxiv-2509-13174.creator: Mengqi Cen, Xuejing Meng, X. Joan Hu, Juxin Liu, Jianhong Wu
arxiv-2509-13174.description: Abstract We extended the Wikle’s Bayesian hierarchical model based on a diffusion-reaction equation ( Wikle 2003 ) to investigate the COVID-19 spatio-temporal spread events across the USA from Mar 2020 to Feb 2022. Our model incorporated an advection term to account for the intra-state spread trend.

arxiv-2602-15774.title: Correlated electronic states at a ferromagnetic oxide interface
arxiv-2602-15774.creator: D. Jones, A. Weh, A. Östlin, D. Braak, T. Kopp, P. Seiler, U. Eckern, L. Chioncel
arxiv-2602-15774.description: Abstract We propose a minimal tight-binding model for the electronic interface layer of the LaAlO 3 /SrTiO 3 heterostructure with oxygen vacancies. In this model, the effective carriers are subject to oxygen vacancy induced magnetic impurities. Both the effects of random on-site potentials and Zeeman-like exchange interactions between correlated carriers and magnetic impurities are taken into account.

pmc-10598914.creator: Kyoung Hoon Kim, Sang Min Lee, Minha Hong, Kyu-Man Han, Jong-Woo Paik
pmc-10598914.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundThe coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic has worsened mental health and reduced access to mental health services. During the pandemic, the demand for telemedicine has increased and related laws have been enacted.

pmc-10725026.title: Development and validation of CT-based radiomics deep learning signatures to predict lymph node metastasis in non-functional pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors: a multicohort study
pmc-10725026.creator: Wenchao Gu, Yingli Chen, Haibin Zhu, Haidi Chen, Zongcheng Yang, Shaocong Mo, Hongyue Zhao, Lei Chen, Takahito Nakajima, XianJun Yu, Shunrong Ji, YaJia Gu, Jie Chen, Wei Tang
pmc-10725026.description: SummaryBackgroundLymph node status is an important factor for the patients with non-functional pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (NF-PanNETs) with respect to the surgical methods, prognosis, recurrence. Our aim is to develop and validate a combination model based on contrast-enhanced CT images to predict the lymph node metastasis (LNM) in NF-PanNETs.

pmc-10832993.title: Development and application of an amplified luminescent proximity homogeneous assay-linked immunosorbent assay for the accurate quantification of kidney injury molecule-1
pmc-10832993.creator: Yulin Fu, Danqin Sun, Yuan Qin, Tianyu Zheng, Zixuan Zhou, Xiumei Zhou, Xueqin Zhao, Yan Xu, Biao Huang
pmc-10832993.description: Background: Kidney injury molecule-1 (Kim-1), a specific marker of kidney injury, is usually not expressed in normal kidneys or at very low levels but is highly expressed in injured renal tubular epithelial cells until the damaged cells recover completely. Therefore, we aimed to develop an efficient and highly sensitive assay to accurately quantify Kim-1 levels in human serum and urine.

pmc-11386271.title: The uptake of the international pressure ulcer/injury prevention and treatment guidelines: An updated systematic citation analysis
pmc-11386271.creator: Monira El Genedy‐Kalyoncu, Jan Kottner
pmc-11386271.description: The European Pressure Ulcer Advisory Panel, National Pressure Injury Advisory Panel, and Pan Pacific Pressure Injury Alliance collaboratively developed three editions of the International Clinical Practice Guidelines for preventing and treating pressure ulcers/injuries in 2009, 2014, and 2019. Dissemination and uptake of these guidelines are important to improve care.

pmc-11478415.title: Canola Oil Ameliorates Obesity by Suppressing Lipogenesis and Reprogramming the Gut Microbiota in Mice via the AMPK Pathway
pmc-11478415.creator: Jing Gao, Li Ma, Jie Yin, Tiejun Li, Yulong Yin, Yongzhong Chen
pmc-11478415.description: Background: obesity is a worldwide problem that seriously endangers human health. Canola oil (Col) has been reported to regulate hepatic steatosis by influencing oxidative stress and lipid metabolism in Kunming mice. However, whether Col exhibits an anti-obesity effect by altering the gut microbiota remains unknown.

pmc-12539140.description: Cancer development is a complex process, initiated by the combination of epigenetic and genetic changes in normal cells. pmc-12563257.title: Alterations in Biochemical Characteristics, Flavor, and Microbial Community During the Storage of Suancai
pmc-12563257.creator: Xingyun Xie, Zehui Li, Hong Liu, Huayi Suo, Zsolt Zalán, Jiajia Song, Yu Zhang, Efstathios Giaouris
pmc-12563257.description: This study examined how storage influences the flavor profile and microbial composition of Suancai. To achieve this, we combined physicochemical measurements with analyses of both volatile and non-volatile metabolites, assessments of microbial diversity, and multivariate statistical modeling. Specifically, we investigated changes in physicochemical parameters, organic acids, amino acids, biogenic amines, volatile compounds, and microbial communities before and after storage.

pmc-12661665.title: Constructing and evaluating a predictive model for the risk of preoperative frailty in breast cancer patients
pmc-12661665.creator: Qianna Fang, Hongmei Jiang, Lingfang Deng, Weiming Sun, Mei Wang, Yu Liu, Jinjiang Xu
pmc-12661665.description: ObjectiveThe aim of this study was to construct and internally validate a prediction model for the risk of preoperative frailty in Chinese breast cancer patients.MethodFrom October 2022 to August 2023, 519 patients were selected who presented for elective surgery in a tertiary hospital of breast surgery in Jinzhou City, China.

pmc-12956855.title: Understanding human metacontrol and its pathologies using deep neural networks
pmc-12956855.creator: Kai J. Sandbrink, Laurence T. Hunt, Christopher Summerfield
pmc-12956855.description: SignificanceComputational systems have to learn when and how they should exert control over their actions. How do agents learn to solve this “metacontrol” problem? Here, we created a task that externalizes this control (through special actions that sample more information about the world or increase efficacy).

pmc-13426425.title: Aptamer-based DNA nanoswitches for multiplexed protein detection
pmc-13426425.creator: Sravya Kovvali, Camryn A. Beckles, Arun Richard Chandrasekaran, Ken Halvorsen
pmc-13426425.description: Simple, modular platforms for detecting biologically relevant proteins are critical for applications in healthcare and research. Here, we have combined aptamer-based protein recognition with our conformationally-responsive DNA nanoswitches to enable simple, sensitive and specific protein detection. We demonstrate dual detection of two clinically relevant blood proteins, thrombin and VEGF as initial proof of concept.
